title: Aliens on time travel and wormholes
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Aliens on time travel and wormholes, about unspecified at craft over Fillmore, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They said that um that they have time travel. They don't like to use it very much because um and especially don't like to do long jumps

plain: A man named Steve Coburn, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says he had contact with beings from a craft over Fillmore, California. According to Coburn, they told him they can travel in time, and the story also touches on wormholes, shortcuts through space. He says they told him they rarely use time travel and especially avoid long jumps, which would mean the visitors have mastered time itself but treat it with caution.
